descriptions.d24f_timed_record_sweep_80345cd0: Walks the record vector: each record whose due word at +4 is not above the limit fires (table slot at +8), posts the current message (0x8016239c), is appended to the destination vector if flag 0x8000 of the object at 0x804b1788 (+188) is set, growing through 0x80212fd4/0x803413d8 when full, and is erased with a tail move. Records hold two extra floats and install table 0x804104b0.
